view: AP portable frontal chest radiograph (supine/semi-erect), L marker on the image right confirming conventional orientation
technical_quality: Limited: portable AP projection in a large-habitus patient with low inspiratory lung volumes; bilateral breast shadows overlie the lower zones; slight rotation; multiple external leads/tubing overlie the thorax. Both apices and lateral chest walls are included; costophrenic angles partly obscured by soft tissue.

devices.location: patient's right anterolateral chest wall, projected over the right mid/lower zone
patient's left upper chest wall, projected over the left upper zone

devices.type: External lead wires / tubing (oxygen tubing or monitor cable)
devices.location: coursing over the left mediastinal border and left lateral hemithorax, and looping over the right lower chest and upper abdomen
image right upper corner, patient's left shoulder

abnormalities.finding: Cardiomegaly (cardiothoracic ratio approx 0.58 on AP projection; partly magnified by technique)
Widened/prominent upper mediastinum with tortuous (unfolded) aorta, likely age- and projection-related
Increased bibasilar interstitial/vascular markings, more prominent in the right perihilar and lower zone (mild vascular congestion or bibasilar atelectasis)
Hazy left basal opacity with obscured left costophrenic angle and partially obscured left hemidiaphragm, suspicious for small left pleural effusion and/or basal atelectasis
Low lung volumes with elevated hemidiaphragms
Degenerative changes of both glenohumeral joints and diffuse osteopenia

description_zh: AP portable 胸部X光，病人體型較大、吸氣量不足，雙側乳影重疊於下肺野，影像品質受限；可見雙側胸壁心電圖電極及導線、上腹部與左側胸壁外來管線，未見胸管、中央靜脈導管、氣管內管或心律調節器。心影擴大（AP 投影下 CTR 約 0.58），上縱膈稍寬且主動脈迂曲，可能與年齡及投影方式有關。雙側下肺野血管及間質紋理增加，以右側肺門周圍較明顯；左下肺野呈模糊陰影並伴左側肋膈角不清，疑似少量肋膜積液或肺底塌陷。未見明確氣胸線、實質性腫塊或肋骨骨折，雙側肩關節呈退化性變化。
